nodes.name: Push Webhook
nodes.notes: Explicit webhookId. Without one n8n registers a mangled fallback path and the endpoint 404s while every layer reports success (CLAUDE.md, 2026-08-17). Auth is the next node and is fail-closed; it decides who may PROPOSE, not who may enrol.

nodes.name: Tool Call In
nodes.notes: Second entry point, so the operator agent can wire this as a toolWorkflow v2.2 tool (toolHttpRequest cannot be an agent tool on this build - it has supplyData but no execute). Same pipeline, same gate: the agent's arrival route changes nothing about who must approve.

nodes.name: Build Proposal
nodes.notes: Makes no network call. Freezes the exact request bodies BEFORE the human is asked, and refuses rather than showing a truncated recipient list.

nodes.name: Ask Human (BLOCKING)
nodes.notes: Calls VIO-agent-tool-ask-human (VIOwf8askhuman1) and BLOCKS. waitForSubWorkflow must stay true: with it false this node would return immediately and the decision node downstream would see an empty payload - which fails closed and enrols nobody, but silently, which is the wrong kind of safe. The sub-workflow's trigger is inputSource=passthrough, so this node's incoming item (action/detail/cost/touches/prior_feedback) is what it shapes into the Slack message.

nodes.name: Decision (fail closed)
nodes.notes: test-push-instantly-gate.mjs reads this jsCode straight out of this file and holds it to the same adversarial payload set as test-ask-human-gate.mjs, with exactly one path to approved:true.

nodes.name: Approved?
nodes.notes: Strict boolean equality against the fail-closed decision - the string 'true' does not pass. This IF is routing, not the gate: the gate is that the true branch leads to a node which throws unless it re-verifies the approval, and which is the only place the Instantly URL exists.

nodes.name: Authorize Enrolment (fail closed)
nodes.notes: The gate. Throws unless the decision is boolean-true AND outcome==='approve', re-checks every address against the text the human was shown, and is the only node in this workflow that contains the Instantly endpoint string.

nodes.name: Enroll Lead (Instantly)
nodes.notes: The only outbound call in this workflow, and it holds no target of its own: both url and body come from Authorize Enrolment (fail closed), so this node is inert unless that gate ran and passed. Method is POST and creates lead records - it never touches a campaign resource. That is not a style choice: per INTEGRATIONS.md, a PATCH to /campaigns/{id} with a sequences body can REACTIVATE a paused campaign, returning a bare 200 that says nothing about the status change (verified live 2026-08-21). push_to_instantly.py contains no activation call at all so that no flag could accidentally send; this workflow preserves that property, and test-push-instantly-gate.mjs asserts no node's parameters contain a campaign, pause or resume endpoint. The VIO Instantly credential supplies the Authorization: Bearer header - do not add one here. The User-Agent header is required: Instantly's leads endpoint answers a default client UA with a bare Cloudflare 1010.

nodes.name: Not Approved (nothing sent)
nodes.notes: Terminal. Nothing is wired downstream of this node, so the false branch is not an idle sibling of the send - it is the end of the graph.
